title: Upright Venice
medium: etching and drypoint printed in dark brownish black on cream laid paper
material: etching and drypoint on cream laid paper
description: (American, 1834-1903) Upright Venice etching and drypoint printed in dark brownish black on cream laid paper circa 1879-80. Edition of approximately 30. Signed with the butterfly and inscribed "imp." in pencil on the tab (lower left). MacDonald's fourth state (of 7), with the figure of the gondolier on the gondola stern center left still partially visible and still a shorter left leg on the second man from the right in the nearest group. A superb, crisp, early impression, with warm plate tone and every detail distinct, including the delicate vertical wiping scratches. [Kennedy 205; Glasgow 232] sheet: 10 x 7 in.

auction_title: Sale 2105 - American Art and Pennsylvania Impressionists
title: Nocturne Palaces
medium: etching and drypoint printed in dark brownish black on ivory laid paper
material: etching and drypoint on ivory laid paper
description: (American, 1834-1903) Nocturne Palaces etching and drypoint printed in dark brownish black on ivory laid paper circa 1879-80. Edition of approximately 54, in all states combined. Signed with butterfly monogram and inscribed imp on the tab. MacDonald's twelfth state (of 12), with the butterfly in the plate, lower left. A beautiful, atmospheric impression of this extremely scarce, important etching, with all the details distinct and richly-inked. [Kennedy 202; Glasgow 200] sheet: 11 5/8 x 7 7/8 in.
